config.experiment: M1B.1 — uniformity metric & observation-scale audit (diagnostics only)
config.diagnostic_only: No controller, stopping rule, q, alpha or dynamics change. Observation scales are diagnostic instruments, never policy inputs.
config.divisibility_note: every B divides every K, so coarse aggregation is exact (no interpolation)

metrics.fine_grid: U_K = K * sum_i (p_i - 1/K)^2  (simulation-scale; identical to all prior rounds)
metrics.observation_scale: U_B = B * sum_b (P_b - 1/B)^2 with P_b = exact aggregate of K/B consecutive bins (B fixed => comparable across K)

config.no_success_thresholds: retention 90/95/99% lines are reading aids only; no near-optimal threshold is defined in advance
regression_anchors: stopping times must match committed M1B epsilon_k_summary.csv
K=100 reference trajectory must match committed M1A.1 long-horizon trajectory
